Path: business reporting | dashboards.chart-type-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade — `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/types` (`ObjectChartSchema.series` in `objectql.ts` and `zod/objectql.zod.ts`) — objectui's contract face ⇒ `domain:spec`; rationale: the published `object-chart` copy of the series arm lacks the per-series `type` the renderer's arm declares, and its `.describe` claims to be that arm. No producer is named for a per-series `type` on `object-chart`, so the answer is not to widen: zero pull ⇒ keep the copy narrower and make the `.describe` say so (a wording fix, no accept-set change) ⇒ p3.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T12:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (TIER_DEFAULT, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs:12534` on objectstack `16c5a33`; `--tier` refuses objectui paths)
Clause-②: no. The accept set does not move; this is a `.describe` and docblock wording fix. `yes` would be owed only if a named producer turned the card to widening, and then the dev stops and reports.
Thread-read: 5832033521
Serial constraints cleared: re-measured on objectui `origin/main` after PR objectui#10734 (objectui#10608) merged at 05:20Z. That was this card's serial predecessor on the `ObjectChartSchema` block, so the constraint is cleared. Of the open PRs, only PR objectui#8941 touches `objectql.ts`, with one docblock line at `@@ -525` (`BulkActionDef`), which is disjoint. No live `pm:dispatched` claim names this block.
